$comment: GOLD pipeline-prompt: the required inputs and expected output of the flow-author agent (UXP-542). Hand-authored reference showing the EXTEND path (clf-017: gift-wrap step added to the existing checkout journey). Output conforms to docs/product-truth/schemas/flow.schema.json. Each step is wired to a screen + read/write entities and carries one acceptance_scenario the business-analyst turns into ACs.
purpose: Assemble (or EXTEND) a draft flow — ordering steps and wiring each to its screen and the entities it reads/writes, with an acceptance_scenario per node — from the drafted mock data and mockups.

classification.user_request: Add an optional gift-wrap step to the existing checkout flow.

mockups.note: new screen drafted by mockup-author, populated from the Order records

search_result.note: A new step in an existing journey is a step ADDED to that flow, not a new flow (README add-vs-create).

expected_output.$realization_note: realization/source stays 'mock' for a drafted-but-unbuilt journey; set to 'real' only once the screens are built. impl_status per node is DERIVED by the generator from each step's implements[] — never hand-authored.

new_step.label: Gift wrap
new_step.human: Before paying, the customer can optionally choose gift wrapping, which is added to the order.
new_step.$implements_note: left empty by flow-author; the business-analyst authors the L2/L3 ACs from the acceptance_scenario below and back-links them via step.implements (UXP-402).

expected_output.reordered: existing checkout/confirmed steps shift order to make room; step ids are stable and unique.

new_acceptance_scenario.given: a cart with at least one item at checkout
new_acceptance_scenario.when: the customer opts into gift wrapping
new_acceptance_scenario.then: the gift-wrap option is recorded on the Order before payment

provenance.note: Inserted the optional gift-wrap step (screen gift-wrap; reads/writes Order) into the existing purchase journey with its acceptance_scenario; did not create a new flow.

rules: ALWAYS search index.json (by_flow / by_component) before writing: a screen that belongs to an existing journey is a STEP ADDED to that flow — extend in place, bump version, append provenance, keep the flow id.
Only CREATE a new <product>/<name>.flow.json when the request is a genuinely new journey.
Every step.screen MUST resolve to a mockup screen id; every reads/writes entity MUST be a member of index.json entity_registry; set mock_data_ref to the populating dataset.
Author exactly one acceptance_scenario per step/branch (schema requires for/given/when/then; 'for' is the step or branch id).
Leave step.implements EMPTY — the business-analyst derives the ACs and writes the back-links (the flow->AC direction is the source of truth).

Set status (active) and readiness (draft). Do NOT hand-author impl_status / impl_summary / by_ac — those are DERIVED. After writing the flow and registering it in index.json artifacts[], run docs/product-truth/scripts/generate_product_truth.py (rebuilds derived data + the .md rendering), then validate_product_truth.py.
